title: Accretion Physics
description: Matter falling onto a compact object turns its gravity into light - up to a third of its rest energy for a spinning black hole, fifty times better than fusion. The brightest things in the universe are lit this way. Unlocks the Accretion Disk Reactor.

puzzle.goal: Light from gas falling onto a mass M pushes on its electrons (cross-section σ) while gravity pulls on its protons (mass m). Write the luminosity L at which the two balance, using G and c.
puzzle.name: Eddington luminosity
puzzle.form: 4 * π * G * M * m * c / σ
puzzle.ask: Find L in units of @{u} W (u = @{u}) for ten solar masses: M = @{M} kg, m = 1.6726e-27 kg, c = 2.998e8 m/s, s = @{s} m², G = 6.674e-11.
puzzle.method: The radiation force on an electron at distance r is σL/(4πr²c); gravity on its proton is GMm/r². The r² cancels.
